symptom: `alter page … set (booleanAttribute: Order_Customer/Active) on sw` on a pluggable widget was a parse error ("takes a plain value, not an expression"), and the quoted spelling was refused ("alter page set cannot bind the path") — the issue as filed expected the plain-name resolver to store it flat; stubbing it in reproduces exactly that, CE1613 "The selected attribute 'MyFirstModule.Order.Order_Customer/Active' no longer exists" on mxbuild 11.16.0.
cause: Three layers each lacked the path: the visitor recognised `Assoc/Attr` only after the ATTRIBUTE keyword (a column's, #1644), so a template key's value parsed as a division; resolvePluggableSetValue knew only plain names, `Module.Entity.Attr` and `$Param.Attr`; and setAttributeBindingValue wrote EntityRef null whatever AttributeBinding.Steps held (only the column setter wrote them).
fix: The visitor hands an `Assoc/…/Attr` expression to the executor as text; ALTER resolves it with #2279's pluggableAssociationAttributePath (same singleValue hop rule, keyed on the stored property's DataSourceProperty) against the scope resolveBindingScope gives, refuses `Mod.Entity/Attr` with MDL-ATTRPATH02's shared message, and the mutator writes Steps as the IndirectEntityRef. check needed no code: it dry-runs applySetProperties. A column property other than Attribute refuses the expression instead of stringifying it as `&{…}`.
insight: Read the issue's claimed symptom against the code before writing the test: the ALTER path never reached the plain-name resolver with a path (a `ContainsAny(attr, "/$")` guard refused it), and the unquoted form never reached the executor at all. The CE1613 is what the naive fix would ship, so the revert proof is a stub of the plain-name call, not a plain revert. Opening the visitor to the path under every key widened a pre-existing hole: SetColumnProperty does `%v` on any value, so an expression became the literal `&{…}`.
test: mdl/executor/alter_set_pluggable_association_path_2283_test.go (altered AttributeRef + steps + SourceVariable equal to a create page control, plain control, second exec Unchanged; refusals in exec and check: refset, backwards reference, unresolved, MDL-ATTRPATH02; forward path passes check; column caption refused)
